## Dell Product and Feature Updates

Dell's enterprise portfolio spans commercial PCs, workstations, servers, storage, data protection, services, and AI-ready infrastructure.

## New Product Launches
- AI-ready PowerEdge server configurations
- Updated Latitude and Precision commercial endpoint lines
- Expanded storage and data protection platforms for enterprise workloads

## Major Feature Updates
- Enhanced support for GPU-heavy AI workloads
- Improved lifecycle and asset management services
- Hybrid cloud and edge infrastructure offerings

## Platform Enhancements
Dell continues to package compute, storage, networking, services, and partner technologies for AI and hybrid IT programs.

## Product Deprecations
- Older endpoint and infrastructure models phase out as refresh cycles move to newer generations

## Regulatory Updates
Contracts should address data protection, secure disposal, supply chain, and support obligations.
